gaps: P0–P1: nothing; P3: nothing usable; P5: nothing
notes: Several hits are Portsmouth, New Hampshire: #4, #7, #12, #13, #14. #2 (Danckerts) is dated only 1645–80, is 1000 px, and shows the town as a faint smudge on the far horizon. #3 (1662) is the Thames reception of Catherine of Braganza, not Portsmouth. #5 (Thomas Taylor’s perspective view from St Helens) is a map-like view dedicated to Queen Anne, so 1702–14, but Commons gives no year; it could stand in for #1 if an event picture is unwanted. #6 (Thomas Elliott, harbor with men-of-war) is dated only “18th century” and the town is a thin strip behind the ships, so P3 left blank. #10/#11 are the same Guildhall photochrom. #16 (2023, HMS Warrior and the dockyard from the Gosport ferry) is a P6 alternative.
